lines.en: I advance toward you inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很慢，但不会停。
lines.en: My steps are slow and never stop.

lines.zh: 黑下来之后，我走得更稳。
lines.en: In the dark I walk more surely.
I scrape along the wall's edge.
Each step drags long.

lines.zh: 你听见我靠近的声音了吗？
lines.en: Hear me closing in?
I do not run. Neither will you.

lines.zh: 我穿过你的走廊，慢慢地。
lines.en: I cross your hallway, slowly.

lines.zh: 路径我很熟，虽然看不见。
lines.en: I know the path, though I cannot see.

lines.zh: 黑屏里，我的脚步一点点近。
lines.en: In the blackout, my steps inch closer.

lines.zh: 你退到哪儿，我走到哪儿。
lines.en: Where you retreat, I follow.
I come very close. No rush.
I stand and wait for you to look up.
After the screen went black, I was here.

lines.zh: 我不动，你的灯也不敢亮。
lines.en: I hold still, and your lamp stays dim.

lines.zh: 我离你再近一点，也不动手。
lines.en: I come nearer without striking.
This room is wrong-dark.

lines.zh: 你听见了呼吸，但那不是你的。
lines.en: A breath. Not yours.
My outline fills the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我等你自己走到我面前。
lines.en: I wait for you to walk to me.
Two of us left on this floor.

lines.zh: 我站着，时间对我无意义。
lines.en: I stand. Time means nothing.

lines.zh: 你的手在摸墙，我在这边。
lines.en: You feel along the wall. I am here.
In the dark, I see you first.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，所以没有声。
lines.en: I need no breath, so I make no sound.

lines.zh: 我把你的蜡烛一支支熄了。
lines.en: I put your candles out one by one.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就开始吧。
lines.en: You see me. Then let us begin.
This dark came with me.
How much can you still see?

lines.zh: 我是这里最要命的之一。
lines.en: I am one of the deadliest here.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的心跳了吧。
lines.en: Hear your own heart?
Light it. It will not help.
I have been walking beside you.
Only now do you notice.

lines.zh: 我看不见，但我找得到你。
lines.en: I cannot see. I still find you.

lines.zh: 你的手举起来了，太晚了。
lines.en: Your hand is up. Too late.

lines.zh: 这栋楼里只有我们两个。
lines.en: Only two of us in this building.

lines.zh: 你想跑向门口，我记得路。
lines.en: The door? I know the way too.

lines.zh: 我的脸在暗里，你看不清。
lines.en: My face is in the dark. You cannot see it.
The more you fear, the slower I go.

lines.zh: 这间屋子已经没有出口了。
lines.en: This room has no way out now.

lines.zh: 你是唯一还活着的气息。
lines.en: You are the only living breath left.

lines.zh: 我等你很久了，真的很久。
lines.en: I have waited a very long time.
The light dies, and I am here.

lines.zh: 你听得见我，就是看不见。
lines.en: You hear me. You cannot see me.
This night will be long.
I retreat into the dark and return.
That did not feel right, did it?
I waver; my outline blurs.

lines.zh: 屏幕一黑，我就慢慢过来。
lines.en: The screen goes black, then I approach slowly.
Pain is a moment to me.

lines.zh: 你打退了我半步，很了不起。
lines.en: You bought half a step. Impressive.
The dark fills me back in.
I withdraw. You stay rooted.
Your hand is going cold.
Still here. Do not celebrate.

lines.zh: 你把食物举起来，看不见吧。
lines.en: You hold food up. You cannot see it.
I eat nothing.
Your hand gropes in the dark.

lines.zh: 灯灭了，东西也就没意义了。
lines.en: Lights out, and the gift means nothing.
You think I care about that?
Lower your hand. Save the strength.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西，自己留着。
lines.en: Keep what you hold.

lines.zh: 再举一会儿，你就看不见了。
lines.en: Hold it longer and you go blind.

lines.zh: 我不需要你给任何东西。
lines.en: I need nothing from you.
Offerings mean nothing in the dark.
You hit me. Very cold.

lines.zh: 我伸手一挡，你的路就没了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and your path ends.
In the dark, what you touched was me.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，你还站在原地。
lines.en: I give half a step. You stay frozen.
You dropped your lamp. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你退了两步。
lines.en: I do not move. You take two steps back.

lines.zh: 身体比这栋楼的墙还冷。
lines.en: Colder than the walls around us.
You push. I have no weight.

lines.zh: 擦过去的时候，你抖了一下。
lines.en: You shiver as I pass.
Touch me again and you should run.
Nothing breeds in the dark.
You cannot even see my face.
I heard the question. I leave now.
In the dark, I am alone.
Your voice shakes. Stop asking.
That is harder to speak of than darkness.
I have one thing to do.
Ask again and I come closer.
Here there are only hunters and prey.

lines.zh: 你把灯点亮，我就不答了。
lines.en: Light the lamp and I stop answering.
The light you dropped, I crush it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我挪了位置。
lines.en: I moved what was on the floor.

lines.zh: 你摸不到它，因为在我手里。
lines.en: You cannot find it. I have it.

lines.zh: 钥匙落地的声音很清楚。
lines.en: A key hitting the floor. Very clear.

lines.zh: 我把它放到你够不到的地方。
lines.en: I put it out of your reach.
No light here. Search if you like.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，慢慢放进口袋。
lines.en: I pick it up and pocket it slowly.

lines.zh: 你听着声音，判断错方向了。
lines.en: You followed the sound wrongly.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，只是不想给你。
lines.en: I do not need it. I just deny it.

lines.zh: 东西不见了，你也不敢找。
lines.en: It is gone. You dare not look.
The screen goes black. So am I here.
I begin to close in slowly.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声暴露了位置。
lines.en: Your breathing gives you away.
I know this dark.
I found you by hearing alone.
The moment the light dies, I arrive.
Not the stairs. Darker there.

lines.zh: 我要的是你最后那口气。
lines.en: I want your last breath.
Put down what you hold.
After the blackout, I am already near.
You hear me, so I am near.
One exit left in this building.
I do not shout. You do.
Now it is you who cannot hear.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声停在你背后。
lines.en: My footsteps stop behind you.
The last step. No need to rush.
Inch by inch. No hurry.
You cannot hear me, and I am close.
The dark closes toward you.
Each light that dies brings me a foot closer.
Back to the wall and there is no path.

lines.zh: 屏幕黑下去，我近了一步。
lines.en: The screen goes black; I take one step closer.

lines.zh: 你开始喘了，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: You are panting. I hear it clearly.
The room keeps shrinking.

lines.zh: 我停一下，让你以为安全。
lines.en: I pause so you feel safe.
Look back. Only black.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声就在你耳边。
lines.en: My breathing is at your ear.

lines.zh: 你摸到的墙，摸到尽头了。
lines.en: You feel the wall to its end.
Two steps more and I strike.
Your blade is trembling.
Your lamp cannot pierce my dark.
The screen goes black, and I take my time.
This room has no window.
Have you heard silence like this?
I am already behind you.
Your screen goes black; I keep coming.
My hand closes on your throat.
You did not see that one.
For the first time, I use force.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的脖子。
lines.en: My fingers close around your throat.
What I grip is your wrist.
Pain? I hear no answer.
That lands on your nape.
You retreat and knock a chair over.
No sound from me. You can only guess.
Slow, and very solid.
Your hand closes on air.
I release, and you gasp.
The dark makes it hurt worse.
You fall loudly.
That was not the last.
Still standing. I am surprised.
The screen went black for a moment.
Every lamp in the house died.
A shape joins the dark.

lines.zh: 我站在你刚才看过的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you just looked.

lines.zh: 你听见楼上有声音，是我。
lines.en: That sound upstairs was me.
The air in this building changed.
I shut the door softly.
Your torch went out.

lines.zh: 我开始走了，从很远的地方。
lines.en: I start walking, from far off.
The hall is dark. I am in it.
Listen. That is not wind.
Someone else is in the bedroom.

lines.zh: 我从黑里走出来一点点。
lines.en: I step a little out of the black.
Your footsteps now echo.
The floor is quiet the wrong way.
I arrive. You will not hear.

lines.zh: 你回头的那一瞬，我出现。
lines.en: I appear the instant you turn.
Something moves in the corner.
The moonlight is blocked.
This night will be very long.
In firelight, I retreat far.

lines.zh: 我落到下一层，没有声音。
lines.en: I drop to the floor below, silent.
Water rises and the dark deepens.

lines.zh: 整间屋子的黑被炸散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters the room's darkness.
The arrow passes through and hits the wall.
A spell holds me briefly.
I do not eat, and I do not weaken.
Lightning whitens the whole building.
The black is no longer dark. It is void.
